subject: Re: Discrepancy: EU entity vs US entity on October ingest — ledger evidence requested
messages:
From: Samantha Li <billing@orchid.ai>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: orchid-finance@orchid.ai
Date: Fri, 29 Oct 2026 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Usage ledger mismatch — EU entity should have been billed (sample attached)

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking a look — quick summary: our October 1–3 ingest shows ~1.2M tokens billed to our US entity (Orchid AI, Inc.) in Redwood's ledger instead of our EU registered subsidiary (Orchid.AI Ltd). As a result Redwood charged VAT on the invoice and routed collection through your US payments flow.

We attached a small sample (usage_export_20261029_sample.csv) with three rows that highlight sessions where tenant tags contain our EU entity_id (eu-orchid-01) but your ledger has org_id=orchid-us-01. The affected window is 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z — 2026-10-03T23:59:59Z.

Immediate asks:
- Can you provide the full ledger export for our account (all token events, org_id, tenant_tag, route_id, model, timestamp) for that window?
- Please hold any collection actions on the October invoice until we reconcile VAT classification — we will owe the net amount but VAT handling differs.
- If you need our EU VAT number: GB987654321 (Orchid.AI Ltd).

We believe this is an attribution / tenant-tag mapping bug during a short ingestion spike. We can share more samples if helpful.

Thanks,
Samantha Li
Finance Lead — Orchid.AI
Samantha.li@orchid.ai
+44 20 7946 0123

Attachment: usage_export_20261029_sample.csv (3 rows, columns: timestamp,session_id,tenant_tag,token_count,model)

From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Li <billing@orchid.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 29 Oct 2026 10:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Usage ledger mismatch — EU entity should have been billed (sample attached)

Hi Samantha — thanks for the sample and clear summary.

Quick acknowledgement and next steps from our side:
1) Ive opened an internal billing incident and flagged this as high priority (incident #RDW-BILL-20261029-81).
2) We will produce a full ledger export (CSV) filtered to the window you specified and include the raw tenant_tag, org_id, route_id, and token counts. Expect a pre-signed S3 link from us within 24 hours.
3) Ill ask Finance to place a temporary hold on collection for the October invoice while we reconcile VAT classification.
4) If the attribution is on our side, Redwood will apply a retroactive tax correction and issue a credit for any VAT difference.

Two questions for your team to help speed the reconciliation:
- Can you confirm whether any of the tenant_tags in your system were migrated or renamed in late September? (Weve seen this cause remapping issues in the past.)
- Would Orchid accept a provisional credit (EUR amount estimate) while we complete the full export and confirm the root cause?

Ill loop in Ben and Neha to produce the export and propose the provisional credit amount for Finance review.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships & Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
